findings: learner.components[1].text: Explain the reported sound match directly in plain language: *maŋ and *mˤaŋ share a similar rhyme but have different initial notation in the Baxter–Sagart system, and qualify that this local comparison alone does not establish 亡’s historical role. The cited evidence supports that distinction (X-4c6c4b681204b7a9040f, X-e44b8137c07c83bfc356).
